$comment: MF-40 admin ads and placements contract (Spec 126 section 6.3 rows 4-6, dated notes 2026-11-10; plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-40/plan.md section 12 and plan.delta-1.md sections 5 and 8; operator "y recommendation: C, with the four trims. approved"). The request schemas of PUT /api/admin/placements/offers (offer_request: create or edit one offer), PATCH /api/admin/placements/offers (toggle_request: turn one offer on or off) and PUT /api/admin/placements/advertisers (advertiser_request: create one advertiser), in MF-42's keyword subset (no format, no conditionals). The enums are LITERALS: placement_key = ad-contract.json slots; building_type and design_option = the two halves of ad-contract.json scenario_fields keys; src/tests/placements-contract.logic.test.ts joins them to ad-contract.json and report-presentation.json ad_placements (both ways). Which targeting keys a placement accepts, and the scenario_card pair rule, are NOT here: the route reads report-presentation.json ad_placements[].targeting and ad-contract.json scenario_fields (one home each; the media precedent of conditionals in the route). zone_class is not a field: it moves to the serving row (trim 1). No active field: offers save inactive and toggle by toggle_request (trim 4). No creative_asset_id field: the picker waits for ad contract v2 (trim 2). creative_text is plain text (the pattern refuses < and >). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD (the RJSF date widget's value), stored as that day at 00:00 UTC. limits name logic_variables keys (values live in the table). Read by src/lib/placements/contract.ts.

offer_request.$comment: offer_id is generated by the page for a new offer (idempotent upsert); updated_at is the value the page read (absent on create); a mismatch is 409.

toggle_request.$comment: The list-row toggle: the offer, the updated_at the list read, and the new active value.

advertiser_request.$comment: Create only (trim 4): the page generates advertiser_id; a second submit of the same id and name is the same row; an advertiser is created active.
